title: spergula rubra subsp. oreophila
intro:
Spergula rubra subsp. oreophila, commonly known as Alpine Sand Spurry or Mountain Sand Spurry, is a plant species belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Spergula rubra subsp. oreophila include its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce inflammation, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
